_readme: Copy this file to config.local.json and fill in real paths. Use forward slashes or doubled backslashes. config.local.json is gitignored and never committed. Fonts are NOT shipped with this kit - bring your own licensed .otf/.ttf.
_game_data: Full path to the <Game>_Data folder, i.e. the one containing StreamingAssets/aa/StandaloneWindows64 and resources.assets.
_work_dir: Writable scratch directory. The kit creates fonts_scan/ and fonts_backup/ inside it. Needs a few GB free.
_font_accent: Accent / display typeface used for headings, names, titles.
_font_body: Body typeface used for the bulk of UI and dialogue text.
_font_digits: Optional. Separate face for digits (often a heavier weight of the body font). Leave empty to reuse font_body.
